title: Executive summary: what this round actually established
headline: Six new mechanisms are built and running: a price-snapshot store, a verified results feed, an originated line (side, then total, then moneyline), a leaderboard that scores signal and staking separately, a replacement-depth model, and correlations that carry their own n. None of them produced a bettable edge, and the summary says why in numbers rather than adjectives.
the_one_paragraph: The results feed is complete and internally consistent (7,413 scored games, 0 arithmetic mismatches). The price store is structurally incomplete: 20,336 market rows, 0 of which have both an opening and a closing number, because the two files that evidence them cover different seasons and neither names a book or a timestamp. The model originates every market but loses to the market on every metric (side MAE 10.741 vs 9.792, Brier 0.241 vs 0.212). The leaderboard has 0 live strategies. One strategy shows a positive ROI and it is the one with the weakest signal -- the exact case the signal/staking split exists to catch -- and the demotion gate sends it back to paper on drawdown and on price loss.
